subject.title: feat(read): persist inbound media to workspace staging

question: Should OpenClaw add a durable workspace-file alias for inbound media in addition to the shipped canonical media-reference path?
rationale: That choice changes the read-only tool contract, workspace-storage lifecycle, and security boundary; the current patch cannot establish that the additional persistence surface is needed merely from its implementation.

options.title: Keep canonical references only
options.body: Close or replace this PR and route any remaining incompatible tool through the shared `media://inbound/<id>` loader.

options.title: Redesign owned staging
options.body: Require a concrete unsupported-tool case, then stage at the inbound-media owner with safe root writes, deterministic naming, and session-scoped cleanup.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical references only
recommendation.body: Close or replace this PR and route any remaining incompatible tool through the shared `media://inbound/<id>` loader.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history directly connects this person to the safe-write contract for `media/inbound` staging.
